_comment: Class prior for single-body wheeled vehicles (WORKFLOW-V3 §5 pickup row, §7 item 10). Data only: the functions (VEH_GROUND, VEH_WHEELS, VEH_MIRROR, the layout measures) live in `rules`. Priors select rules; they never fabricate observations.
roleHint: pick the nearest real one (a fender is "body", a door panel is "cab", a tread ring is "tyre", a lamp lens is "headlight")
_ground_comment: VEH_GROUND: only groundRoles may reach y = 0, every wheel assembly bottom sits on y = 0, the chassis underside is inside limits.v7.ground_clearance.
_frame_comment: The layout frame: L = z extent of lengthRoles, W = their x extent, H = the model's max y. wheelRoles form one wheel assembly (VEH_WHEELS, LK/census).
_roleIdColours_comment: Role -> flat id colour for the ID PASS. CLOSED: one entry per role; widely separated for an 8-bit sRGB round trip.

likeness._comment: scripts/likeness.mjs. areaFamilies group the regions.json zones of a single-body vehicle. faceRole/faceZones/facePaletteKey name the two flat body tones (the +X flank the renderer presents is `front`, the +Z nose is `side`); faceRoles is the box app.js projects as the render's front quad (the flank from y 0 to the roof, bumpers and mirrors excluded, the same frame measure-vehicle emits as _frame.quadPx). visibleInstances: roles whose target shows FEWER instances than the census counts (2 wheels + the far-front tyre sliver = 3; windshield + near side window = 2). Wheel evidence, refs/pickup_truck.png (1024 px): dark tyre components near front x 318..546 (part of the 16958 px body-outline blob), near rear x 734..919 y 466..654 (15438 px), far front sliver under the front bumper x 122..237 y 691..746 (633 px); the far rear wheel is hidden. The template shows the sliver with a 0.06 m bumper depth (scripts/template-vehicle.mjs CLASS_DEFAULTS.bumperD).
likeness._inkOpen_comment: V5-5 item 2 (scripts/accuracy.mjs targetOf): per family, target px that do not survive an opening of this radius (px) are ink strokes / AA slivers — don't care, never target.
likeness._instanceRoles_comment: WF-R3 H2: the roles ONE instance is made of — a wheel's tyre ring and hub are part of that wheel: they count toward its visible px and blob and never occlude it (the far-front wheel shows only as a tyre sliver under the bumper).
likeness._unmeasuredFamilies_comment: WF-R3 R3-B item 6: LK_AREA lamp is UNVERIFIED on this target (the lamps are on the nose, outside the flank quad: share under 0.2 %), so the ACCEPTANCE block does not promise it.
likeness._silhouette_comment: WF-R3 R3-B item 5: LK_SILHOUETTE, blocking from P0. Region = rules/vehicle.mjs silhouetteBox (cab front corner above window.front.top, cab.start .. the measured rake at the roof). Band from the frozen start renders (test/fixtures/vehicle/silhouette-*): box cab 0.911, raked template 0.969.

silhouette.what: the cab front does not follow the target's raked windshield (the roof's front edge sits where the rake meets the roof)

likeness._faceMinShare_comment: WF-R5 R5-A: a face tone of role cab must cover >= 8 % of its px. The capture is flat unlit (sideTint 0): the cab is ONE tone, and the unconstrained reference's handle / door-groove inlays (bed tone, ~1-4 % of the cab px) were read as the return face (body_front/body_side 0.81, body_front 0.82x).

_paletteZones_comment: scripts/calibrate-palette.mjs: palette key -> regions.json zone; point/radius is the fallback sample, verified against the region median; for = what the key paints, printed in the prompt. WF-BLIND-R2 C10: CLOSED, one author key per material; a part in any other zone fails PALETTE_ZONE. The headlight lenses are `lamp` (region headlight) — blind Gemini's uncalibrated `headlight` zone rendered #828282. `closure: true` entries are likeness closure only, not author keys.

paletteZones.for: cab, hood, bed walls, tailgate, door panels and strips: the painted body
the bed floor and the inside of the bed
the windshield and the side windows
the headlight lenses (role headlight) — the only lamp key; region headlight

paletteZones.source: regions.json tread (median recorded there; palette closure)
regions.json body_front (median recorded there; palette closure)

_knobPriors_comment: WORKFLOW v4 V4-2 (scripts/template-vehicle.mjs KNOBS, scripts/fit.mjs): the FIT range of every knob no verified layout key bounds, as start +/- span x L / W / H (of "m": metres), or explicit min / max (metres; exponent for the arch n). locked = never fitted (why). V5-9 EVIDENCE HIERARCHY (orchestrator ruling): a knob STARTED at a verified layout key is ranged here too (plausibility), never by the key's V12 tolerance (the keys were measured earlier at lower resolution; the per-feature accuracy report outranks them); _keyed = such a knob with no entry of its own; _readyCall = the +/- span of every READY-call rc_* knob (scripts/loop.mjs knobifyCalls; min clamped at 0.001). Spans cover the Opus 5.5 free-hand reads on refs/pickup_truck.png (out/ref/work/pickup.mjs: roof front 0.355 L, cab-back lean 0.573 L, body bottom 0.24 H, taper 0.079 m, arch 0.58 m half-width, bumper wraps). _unverifiedKey = a knob whose layout key is unverified.

L.locked: registration anchor: the template metric length (CLASS_DEFAULTS.length)

clearance.locked: the chassis underside is hidden from the solved camera (chassis.clearance unverified)

_zoneIouMin_comment: WORKFLOW v4 V4-5A: the per-zone (area family) IoU BAND of the target stop (scripts/loop.mjs atTarget) and of FIT's shortfall term (scripts/fit.mjs). Calibrated on the Opus accuracy-ceiling module out/ref/work/pickup.mjs (= test/fixtures/v4/work-pickup.mjs), registered per-family IoU body 0.844, glass 0.847, dark 0.742, light 0.757, lamp 0.893, minus a 0.01 margin. Blind Luna's BUILD module (0.9779 whole) sits at dark 0.726, light 0.745, lamp 0.823: all three below band.
_zoneProposals_comment: V4-5A: what a ZONE residual row (a family below its band) proposes to the seat — the knobs (template or READY-call rc_* prefixes) and helper calls that own that family's px.

body.text: the body outline: hood / cab / bed edges (knobs), the raised hood panel K.assemble.hoodPanel

glass.text: the panes (K.assemble.pane poly corners) and the mirror heads (K.assemble.mirror head.w / h / round)

dark.text: tyre size and width (wheelR, wheelWidth), the grille slot field (K.assemble.grille bounds / slots), the arch liners (arch*Half / arch*Rise)

light.text: the dished hubs (wheels.hub r / ring / cap) and the bumpers (bumper*Top / H / Depth / Out)

lamp.text: the headlight lenses (K.assemble.lamp centre / diameter, flush: true)

_residualFloor_comment: WORKFLOW v4 V4-2 ruling: the residual NOISE FLOOR (scripts/residuals.mjs). A row is SHOWN (result.shown, the text a seat reads) only when it is >= metres AND >= px (target px, refs 1024 px wide); every row over the 0.5 x tol cut stays in result.rows for diagnostics. Calibrated on the Opus accuracy-ceiling module out/ref/work/pickup.mjs (registered IoU 0.9733): 27 rows over the 0.5 x tol cut, all ink / AA edge bands of 0.05..0.14 m; px 900 leaves 4 (cab front -0.068 m 2044 px, windshield front +0.087 m 1881 px, cab bottom +0.061 m 1271 px, hood front -0.053 m 1067 px).
layoutUnits: L is your body length (the z extent of chassis/body/cab/hood/bed/bed_wall/tailgate), W their x extent, H the model's height: a value in L, W or H multiplies those. Fix L, W and H once, in P0.
_variants_comment: V4-7: body VARIANTS. subject.json `variant` picks one; scripts/subject.mjs applies its `overrides` on top of this prior (top-level keys replace, likeness / knobPriors merge). The variant also picks the landmark set of scripts/measure-vehicle.mjs / measure-profile.mjs and the body of scripts/template-vehicle.mjs. No variant = pickup (open bed + hood + cab).

pickup.body: hood + cab + open bed (K.assemble.vehicleBody bed / hood)

bus.body: one flat-nosed box, role cab from the nose to the tail (no hood, no bed): K.assemble.vehicleBody({ hood: false, bed: null, plan: chamfered front corners }); details: K.assemble.windowRow (band + pane row, both flanks), pane x 2 on the nose (split windshield), lamp (headlights; turn lenses role prop), mirror (black heads), stopArm (near flank)
bus.zones: regions.json zones the bus instrument needs: body_side, body_front, roof, glass, tyre, black, hub, headlight (+ amber, orange, signal lenses)

likeness._visible_comment: refs/school_bus.png: the two near wheels only (no far tyre shows under the bumper); windows = the 2 windshield panes + the 7 near row panes (the entrance-door pane behind the near mirror is not built: window.door UNVERIFIED)

overrides._paletteZones_comment: The bus palette (CLOSED, replaces the pickup list): black is ONE paint on this target (bumpers, window band + pillars, mirror heads and arms, the stop-arm post); signal = the stop-sign face and the red marker lenses; amber = the turn lenses; orange = the amber marker lenses.

paletteZones.for: the painted body (the bus box, its nose and cap)
the windshield panes and the side panes
black paint: bumpers, the window band and pillars, mirror heads and arms, the stop-arm post, arch liners
tyre discs, tread rings and the chassis
the stop-sign face and the red roof-marker lenses
the amber turn lenses under the headlights

paletteZones.source: regions.json roof (the lit roof: palette closure)

body.text: the box outline: nose top, the front cap's depth, the corner chamfer, the sill (knobs)

glass.text: the split windshield (K.assemble.pane x 2) and the pane row (K.assemble.windowRow)

lamp.text: headlight and turn lenses (K.assemble.lamp), the stop sign (K.assemble.stopArm)
